objections: CAT sits in Industrials, the sector I rotated out of this week because the selling is concentrated in the heavy cap-weighted names the ETF holds, and at -7.6% on the week and -10.7% over four weeks CAT is one of those names being sold, so a 20% position runs directly against my call.
